newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent looks up, NYMEX extends late rally.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent looks up, NYMEX extends late rally.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures were untraded but indicated higher at midday on Monday in Asia, as a short-covering rally raised NYMEX values.
August Brent on SIMEX was quoted at $17.75/$17.95 per barrel, after London dropped 11 cents to settle at $17.67.
NYMEX crude futures were firmer on ACCESS, as a late short-covering rally in New York on Friday spilled over into Monday's action.
In addition, a United Nations threat over the weekend of new sanctions against Iraq, added some bullish background to the market, brokers said.
NYMEX August crude, which took over the first position slot Monday, was last traded at $19.11 per barrel, up 20 cents from New York where the contract had slipped three cents.

NYMEX July gasoline reversed its New York losses by midday in Asia to stand at 56.20 cents per gallon, up 0.72 from New York where it had shed 0.61 in value. However, volume was extremely light at just 49 lots.
